archives.PS_READERS_RECORDS.zip: Every remaining project file except explicitly superseded intermediate PDFs, with exact-byte duplicate images represented by records/FILE_ALIASES.tsv.

excluded: Original supplied inputs, earlier ZIP archives, interpreter bytecode caches, and the exact superseded intermediate PDF versions listed in records/FINAL_OMISSIONS.tsv.
